leadText:
Pocket Monsters Zensho (Japanese: まんが版 ポケットモンスター全書 Pocket Monsters Complete Book Comics Edition) is a shōnen Pokémon manga directly based on the Pokémon games. It follows the plot of closer than any other Pokémon manga.

This manga covers several details that are not found in other manga or , such as the hunt for the Safari Zone Warden's dentures. It ends with the defeat of the Elite Four.

The entire manga was released by Shogakukan in a single volume containing 10 chapters. It is written and illustrated by Satomi Nakamura.
